products.title: Super Pack Mystica Legacy Carbon Hybrid Blue 2024 - Mystica
products.description:
SUPER PACK MYSTICA LEGACY CARBON HYBRID BLUE 2024 - One of the packs with the best quality-price ratio on the market. The Mystica racket is without a doubt a complete racket, in an oversize format and in 3K carbon. Take the leap to the track with the SUPER PACK MYSTICA LEGACY CARBON HYBRID BLUE 2024, a perfect combination for those looking for performance and complete equipment. The Mystica Legacy Carbon Hybrid Blue 2024 is a hybrid racket that offers an excellent balance between control and power. Its 3K carbon construction provides great resistance and a solid response to each hit, making it a very versatile option to face any game situation.

products.title: Wilson Active Perforated Cap - Caps
products.description:
WILSON ACTIVE PERFORATED CAP - Get the Wilson active perforated padel cap. Designed for competitive players looking for the best quality and high protection from the sun. The WILSON ACTIVE PERFORATED CAP has been manufactured with quick-drying technical materials, with the main objective of keeping sweat under control and protecting from the sun without being overwhelming. Its curved visor offers effective shade without interfering with vision. 

Its light and flexible structure adapts comfortably to the head, while the side perforations allow constant ventilation even on the hottest days.

Recommended for a padel player who wants to be elegant and not lose points in their most important matches for the typical excuse of the sun.

products.title: Wilson Courtglide White White White - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON COURTGLIDE WHITE WHITE WHITE - The new padel shoes perfect for everyday life. You can use them both casually and for intensive use on the track. Wilson Padel has launched its new line of padel footwear for the 2026 season. These new WILSON COURTGLIDE WHITE WHITE WHITE are a basic model in white, vintage style, a safe bet within Wilson's mid-range. This model is designed to offer the player high comfort and stability.

They incorporate advanced technologies, such as the Duralast rubber sole, with a type of pattern similar to clay, optimized for padel, which provides us with constant traction on the court, helping to make more controlled changes of direction and stable movements.

The R-DST midsole balances cushioning and response. It absorbs impacts without disconnecting the player from the ground, allowing a natural and comfortable footprint during training and recreational matches.

We recommend them for players who are starting or have an intermediate level. Without a doubt, a shoe that, due to its design, attracts a lot of attention to be worn even on a daily basis.

products.title: Varlion Avant Cti Difusor Black - Varlion
products.description:
VARLION AVANT CTI DIFFUSER BLACK - This model stands out for its light weight and oversized shape, which on the court leaves us with superior balance for both control shots and power shots. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The VARLION AVANT CTI DIFFUSOR BLACK, a racket made with bidirectional carbon fiber in the tubular with which we will obtain durability and lightness in this area. It is a teardrop-shaped and quite light racket, recommended for players who want a low weight and complete racket.

PLAYER TYPE

The level of this racket is medium-advanced. Ideal for both offensive and defensive players since its teardrop shape will help us play well in any area.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The Varlion rackets are still in fashion, and this VARLION AVANT CTI DIFFUSER BLACK is one of the most desired by male and female players due to its black and pink details.

Made in a teardrop mold, with a rough surface.

Its planes are made of fiberglass, which translated into the court gives us ball output, which is very good since this way the player has to use less force to pass the ball to the opposite side.

Another feature of this racket is the diffuser, a key piece that balances the structure and also gives it an impressive design.

PLAY STYLE 

It is a clue to say that it is a very complete racket with which both male and female players will feel very comfortable with it.

products.title: Super Pack Drop Shot Carat Pro - Drop Shot
products.description:

The pack offers the racket, a Premium backpack, 10 quality overgrips so that you forget about having to buy it for a while, 1 protector and 1 can of balls to use it for the first time the same day you receive it. SUPER PACK DROP SHOT CARAT PRO is a pack designed for players looking for extra power without giving up good control. A balanced, comfortable model with very good performance on the track.

Along with the racket you will receive a Premium backpack, 10 overgrips for various substitutions, a protector that will help preserve the frame better and a can of balls so you can try it on the court as soon as you get home.
